compliance.footer: There is no way to send around these checks, and that is deliberate: a message sent without a registered permission is the one that carries a fine.
compliance.pageSubtitle: What we are allowed to send, what we hold about people, and how we ask for reviews.
compliance.registryLive: Marketing permissions are registered with İYS through {gateway}.
compliance.registryLocal: Permissions are recorded here but not registered with İYS: this deployment is wired to “{gateway}”. Until a licensed service provider is connected, no commercial message will be sent.
compliance.overdueBody: {count, plural, one {# permission has} other {# permissions have}} passed the three business days Turkish law allows for reporting them. They are still queued and will be sent as soon as a provider is connected.
compliance.optedOutBody: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} asked not to be contacted. They are excluded from every send, whatever a list or a segment says.
compliance.gatingBody: Review-gating means asking happy customers for a public review and routing unhappy ones somewhere private. It is against Google's policy and it is dishonest. This product cannot do it, and that is a property of how it is built rather than a setting somebody could change.
compliance.gatingPoint1: The function that decides where a review is asked for is never given a rating or a sentiment. There is nowhere to put one.
compliance.gatingPoint2: A survey has no review destination of its own — it points at a collection campaign, decided before anyone answers. A 2 and a 10 see the same invitation.
compliance.gatingPoint3: An audience cannot be filtered on a score. Contact filters and saved segments carry no rating field.

kvkk.title: KVKK: export and erasure
kvkk.body: Anyone may ask what you hold about them, and ask you to delete it. Search by the email address or phone number they gave you.
kvkk.adminOnly: Handling subject requests needs an administrator.
kvkk.noMatch: Nothing is held about that email address or phone number.
kvkk.eraseWarning: This cannot be undone. Their reviews stay, with the author removed.
